csv_project_name: Developer Services for Walton & One Mixed-Use - Hotel Site 1
csv_agency: City of Port St Lucie Procurement
csv_scope_of_work: This RFP seeks an experienced hotel developer in a mixed-use setting which includes retail/restaurants on the ground floor of the project. The successful hotel developer shall construct a minimum of a 100- to-125 bed hotel with ground floor retail/restaurants that meets the following goals and objectives. The Agency s desired development of Walton & One is to create a mixed-use commercial center/destination that will feature uses including entertainment/sports, residential, retail, office, dining, and social gathering space needs of the City and region. The hotel developer s experience should demonstrate forward-thinking approaches to urban design, architecture, engineering, environmental technologies, and the public realm, as well as a focus on placemaking. The proposed hotel should have a national brand affiliation which would make the hotel attractive to commercial, meeting and group, and leisure market segments.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Design Build/Developer, Urban Studies/Planning/Design
csv_comments: '* * * ADVANCE NOTICE * * *Project Info: *** UPDATED SECTIONS (Comments) **** The RFP/Q has been canceled and may be re-advertised in the future.* IMS requests NO PHONE CALLS, NO FAZES, and NO CONTACT with agency at this time.- IMS will continue to monitor project developments and will update when new information becomes available.
title: Developer Services for Walton & One Mixed-Use - Hotel Site 1
short_description: Canceled advance notice for a mixed-use hotel development with ground-floor retail and restaurants.
project_scope: Mixed-use hotel development at Walton & One in Port St. Lucie. The successful developer was to deliver a nationally branded hotel with a minimum of 100 to 125 beds and ground-floor retail/restaurants as part of a broader mixed-use destination including entertainment/sports, residential, retail, office, dining, and social gathering spaces. The notice emphasizes urban design, architecture, engineering, environmental technologies, public realm quality, and placemaking.
services: Developer services / design-build development services; architecture services; urban studies/planning/design.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a developer solicitation, not a direct structural engineering or specialist design tender.
- Project is a hotel/mixed-use building without clear indication of complex long-span or special structural systems.
- Some relevance due to mixed-use urban development context and stated interest in architecture, engineering, and environmental technologies.
- Lower priority because the notice is canceled and may be re-advertised later.
- Building type is not among sbp's strongest target sectors such as bridges, stadiums, long-span roofs, or major cultural/university buildings.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the notice. Available scope information: mixed-use hotel with 100 to 125 beds and ground-floor retail/restaurants within a larger destination development. This is insufficient for a reliable USD estimate without area, quality level, parking, site works, or procurement details.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. As this is a developer/design-build solicitation rather than a defined structural engineering package, an sbp fee cannot be estimated reliably from the notice.
references_qualifications: Experienced hotel developer in a mixed-use setting; experience should demonstrate forward-thinking approaches to urban design, architecture, engineering, environmental technologies, public realm, and placemaking; proposed hotel should have a national brand affiliation attractive to commercial, meeting/group, and leisure segments.
contracting_authority: City of Port St. Lucie, Florida, USA. Contact: Nate Rubel. Email: nrubel@cityofpsl.com. Phone: 772-344-4230. Website: https://procurement.opengov.com/portal/cityofpsl/projects/231818
notes: Advance notice only. The RFP/Q has been canceled and may be re-advertised in the future. IMS requests no phone calls, no faxes, and no contact with the agency at this time. Project #: 852164-1; ProjectID: 1013196; Original date: 2026-02-18; Current date in sheet: 2026-06-22.
